name: cognicrew
description: CogniCrew - FastAPI backend serving the static frontend

scripts.dev: bash -c 'if curl -k -s -o /dev/null -m 2 https://127.0.0.1:4000/health; then echo "CogniCrew already serving on :4000"; sleep infinity; else exec ./.venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000 --app-dir backend --ssl-keyfile certs/localhost-key.pem --ssl-certfile certs/localhost.pem; fi'
scripts.start: bash -c 'if curl -k -s -o /dev/null -m 2 https://127.0.0.1:4000/health; then echo "CogniCrew already serving on :4000"; sleep infinity; else exec ./.venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000 --app-dir backend --ssl-keyfile certs/localhost-key.pem --ssl-certfile certs/localhost.pem; fi'
